regions.merged_text: God bless you Joseph and Winnie. Just a few words this time to catch you before going S.W. - in case you desid it necessary. An enrolling "Emergent-lenager and Employees of O'Donell's Texas Pruit Parm." I hope things smoothe off without any serious difficulty- and that the trouble prove "just a little ripple on the surface ..... Many thanks for your kind favor of Sept. 6. I had my two Rev. Brothers Misgr Ed and Fr. M. E. Joachim last week. The latter left yesterday. Expect former back from Boston in week or so ..... Again many thanks and God love and keep you both .... Just say the Our Father sloly and devoutly for above trouble.
